analysis.completion_evidence: PR #201 created on fix/whatsapp-parity with per-fix commits; final test run shows 13 files / 53 tests passing, ultracite 'No fixes applied', typecheck clean, pushed tip 30cbb44 'Revert fix(whatsapp-business): carry sender profile name'. Earlier runs show 56 tests passing before revert and the partial-send/poison-event tests added. Diff shows new content/template.ts, errors/partial-send.ts, index.ts exports, messages.ts imports of asReply/asVoice/TemplateInput. Explanation turns were answered in text. The final diff (linked_commit) also contains unrelated platforms→providers rename edits across docs/core that are not from this session.
analysis.notes: Many turns are explanatory Q&A reacting to the specific implementation; a replay with a different model may have a different set of fixes, so c15 is deliberately generic. The final diff is linked_commit and includes a large unrelated platforms→providers rename across docs and core that appears to be outside this session; the diff is also truncated so the sender-name revert and messages.ts body aren't visible, but the transcript's final test run (53 tests, revert commit 30cbb44) supports completion. The partial-send error (c14) was the assistant's proposal that the user implicitly accepted via turn 8; the user's own requirement was only stream safety. Turn 26 and 27 are near-duplicates (turn 26 got no response).
analysis.task_statement: Starting from a user bug report that WhatsApp Business quoted replies arrive as plain text, the user asked for a deep parity audit of the whatsapp-business provider against iMessage, then had the assistant branch, plan (with many clarifying questions and Meta-API verification), and implement the fixable gaps as a PR with tests. Follow-ups covered a CodeRabbit review finding on partial group sends (user's only hard requirement: the inbound stream must never break), extensive explanation of the changes for manual review, a check that the new shapes survive spectrum-webhook delivery, and finally removal of the sender-name fix because it would require changes in another repo.
